messages:
olivia: heads up — getting reports of duplicate SSE events after reconnects. client reconnects with Last-Event-ID and ends up receiving the last event twice; console shows doubled token/billing for affected routes.

sam: which route/region? any quick repro?

olivia: eu-prod streaming route, seen in a couple tenants. quick repro below.

olivia: repro steps:
1) open stream -> get event id `evt-42`
2) disconnect (idle)
3) client reconnects with header `Last-Event-ID: evt-42`
4) server responds 204 resume-check but proxy also forwards the cached last event -> client processes `evt-42` twice

olivia: curl reproduction:
```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Last-Event-ID: evt-42" 
  "https://eu.api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?model=open-llm"
```
observed server lines: `HTTP/1.1 204 No Content` then chunked `id:evt-42
data: {...}`

tara: sounds like a race between resume validation (204) and the cached fanout that replays last chunk. proxy may be allowed to emit a cached tail while control-plane is still reconciling lease.

manuel: we changed edge behavior in commit 9c3f4 last quarter to *allow* resume attempts to pass through while lease absent to reduce failed reconnect UX. that likely re-enabled the path where both a cached replay and a resume response race.

sam: could explain billing dup: both the reconnect attempt and the replay count as active tokens/requests in console accounting. console attribution stacks them.

infra-bot: ALERT: stream-route:eu-prod token-usage spike detected - 480% above baseline in last 5m (auto-tag: last-eventid-resume).

deploy-bot: canary rollout paused on eu-prod streaming proxy 2026-03-20T14:12Z due to increased error budget.

tara: short-term mitigation: strip `Last-Event-ID` on proxy if the session lease isn't present/valid. that prevents the server from doing a replay handshake and avoids double emit. low risk and reversible with flag.

sam: long-term we should unify resume semantics: either strict resume-only-with-lease (no replay) or resume-with-replay-plus-idempotency enforcements. also need telemetry: `resume_attempt`, `replay_emitted`, `lease_presence`, `proxy_response_code` at route level.

manuel: I'll open PR to edge-proxy to stop forwarding `Last-Event-ID` when lease lookup returns miss. will gate behind `edge.resume_strip_on_lease_miss` flag. also add log lines: `RESUME_STRIP reason=lease_miss route=%s`

olivia: please also add a console dashboard card: `streaming.resume_dup_rate` (percent of reconnects that correlate with duplicate event receipts). alert if > 0.5% for > 10m.

tara: agree. also add a telemetry tag to billing events so we can exclude / identify reconnect-induced double charges while we assess. label: `billing.cause=resume_replay`

manuel: assigning to self for PR + will add telemetry keys. timeline: PR by EOD, canary tomorrow with flag off by default.

sam: i'll do the dashboard + alert rule. can you add an example log payload we can use for the dashboard?

manuel: example log line (json): `{"ts":"...","route":"eu-prod","event":"RESUME_STRIP","lease":"miss","last_event_id":"evt-42","client_ip":"1.2.3.4"}`

olivia: perfect. also collect a small sample of full request/response traces for 10 afflicted requests to root-cause parsing errors if any.

infra-bot: NOTE: ticket created #PLAT-9982 "strip Last-Event-ID on lease miss + telemetry" assigned to manuel.

olivia: thanks team. once canary shows reduction in dup rate we'll flip flag and update docs/rollout notes.

sam: one more follow-up: postmortem should include why resume UX change (9c3f4) lacked telemetry to catch this earlier.

tara: and add a console UX note: make resume vs sticky-lease explicit in route config to avoid surprises.

manuel: will update PR with config option and docs snippet.

olivia: great, closing loop for now — will watch the dashboard and re-open if dup persists.
